name: Batch 06 · Pulse and personality
status: Imported into hosted Playlist Lab for review; Spotify candidate order verified. Not a host-approved party sequence.
selection_method: 50 distinct lead artists; five interleaved lanes; partial Batch05 evidence plus earlier Keep/Cut patterns. All 291 prior library URIs/ISRCs and same-artist compositions excluded.

feedback_basis.source: Hosted Playlist Lab SQLite read-only snapshot
feedback_basis.interpretation: Partial votes only; new batch is requested but completion of Batch05 is not inferred.

audit.identity_source: Spotify Web API US search followed by exact-ID GET /tracks readback; all URI, ISRC, title, artists and duration match; all 50 US-playable.
audit.listening_status: Not a full listening or audio-analysis pass; dead space, repetition, edits and lyrics remain host audition questions.
